name: Power-up cancelled by a dead end (reverse)
expected: Tick 1: dust on the start cell: Clean = clean_up.
Tick 3: at (4,2) F, L, R all true: Disable Move Forward, clean_off, Enable Move Backward (C11, R4).
Tick 6: reverse of 3 ticks done, left free: Turn Left.
function_text: EF-12 – Dust: power-up (clean_up) for 3 ticks, then back to clean_on
EF-14 – An obstacle during power-up cancels the power-up
EF-10 – Boxed in (F, L, R): move backward for at least 3 ticks, continue while both sides are blocked
EF-11 – Reverse ends with a turn, left first
